public.hero.intro: Ka tāpirihia e Mecropolis ngā heat units (GDD) mai i ngā pāmahana Open-Meteo kua tuhia mai i te whakatōnga. Ka eke te tapeke ki te paepae o te hua, ka neke te kaupeka o Western Cape ki te wāhanga whai muri.

public.how.title: Mai i te rā whakatō ki te wāhanga
public.how.lead: Ko te tikanga, ka tāurua ā-ringa te wāhanga, nō reira ka tika noa ki te whakahou whakamutunga. I konei, ka tātaihia mai i ngā huarere kua tuhia, ā, ka tiakina ngā taunakitanga o ia panonitanga.
public.step.1.title: Tuhia ngā mōhio a te kaiahuwhenua
public.step.1.body: Ka tiakina ngā pāmu, ngā māra, ngā hua me ngā rā whakatō ki Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Tikina ngā huarere kua pā
public.step.2.body: Ka ahu mai ngā pāmahana o ia rā mō ngā taunga o te māra i te pūranga Open-Meteo, mai i te whakatōnga ki tēnei rā.
public.step.3.title: Tāpirihia ngā heat units
public.step.3.body: Ka tāpirihia ngā heat units (GDD) e ai ki te tauira hua. Ka hipa i tētahi paepae, ka neke te pūnaha i te kaupeka ki te wāhanga whai muri, ā, ka tuhi i te take.
public.models.title: Ngā tauira hua e whakamahia ana
public.models.lead: Ngā heat units e hiahiatia ana kia pakari te hua i te mahana. He mea tuhi ā-ringa ēnei tautuhinga, ā, kāore anō he puna kōrero.
public.live.title: Ngā āhuarangi i te pāmu whakamātau o Swartland
public.live.lead: Ngā inenga mai i ngā puna tūmatanui, ka whakahoungia ia 30 meneti.
public.yields.title: Ngā paerewa hua kua whakaputaina
public.honesty.title: Te whakahaere raraunga
public.honesty.1.title: Ka tāuru ā-ringa te kaiwhakahaere i te hua
public.honesty.1.body: Kia tuhi rā anō te kaiwhakahaere i te hua, ka whakaatu te taupānga i “Kāore anō kia tuhia”.
public.honesty.2.title: He raraunga motuhake ngā paearu
public.honesty.2.body: Ka tiakina motuhaketia ngā tatauranga ā-rohe, ā-motu hoki, me te pūtake me te waeine. Kāore e whakatauritea ki te hua o tētahi māra.
public.honesty.3.title: He raraunga ā-rohe ngā riha
public.honesty.3.body: Ka whakaaturia ngā kitenga GBIF i roto i te 100 km, me te tawhiti.
public.honesty.4.title: He raraunga huarere mataora
public.honesty.4.body: Ka tikina ngā paemahana i te pūranga Open-Meteo ina tonoa.
public.open.title: Huakina tētahi kaupeka
public.open.body: Takiuru ki te papatohu whakamātau kia kite i te ānau GDD o tētahi kaupeka me ngā taunakitanga mō tōna wāhanga.

public.about.title: Mō tēnei
public.about.heading: Mō Mecropolis
public.about.lead: He pūnaha aroturuki māra, hua hoki a Mecropolis mō tētahi pāmu i Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Te take i hangaia ai
public.about.why.body: Ka tawhito ngā wāhanga kua tuhia, ā, ka tuhia ngā hua mā te maumahara. Ka tātai a Mecropolis i te wāhanga mai i ngā huarere kua tuhia. Nā tētahi kaiwhakahaere, nā tētahi pūtake tūmatanui kua whakaingoatia rānei ia tau.
public.about.design.title: Hoahoa
public.about.design.1.body: Ka whakaemihia ngā rā wera whakatipu mai i te rā whakatō, mā te pūranga Open-Meteo. Ka tiakina ngā taunakitanga o ia panonitanga wāhanga: te rā i tīmata ai, te tapeke GDD me te pūtake o te tātai.
public.about.design.2.body: Ka tapaina te wāhanga i muri i te wā i mua i te hauhake ko te pakeketanga nā te mahana, nā te mea kāore he hauhaketanga i tuhia.
public.about.design.3.lead: Mā te kaiwhakahaere te hua e tuhi.
public.about.design.4.body: Ka tiakina motuhaketia me te pūtake, te waeine me te raihana.
public.about.stack.title: Hangarau
public.about.stack.body: He taupānga whārangi kotahi Vite me React 19 kei Cloudflare Pages. Ka pānui tika te pūtirotiro i te huinga raraunga Sanity tūmatanui mā GROQ me tētahi kaiwhakarongo wā-tūturu. Ka haere ngā tuhinga me ngā raraunga whai kī mā Cloudflare Pages Functions, e tirotiro ana i tētahi pihikete wātū kua waitohua. Ko Zod kei ngā paenga, ko Vitest mō ngā whakamātautau, ko Tailwind 4 mō te āhua.
public.about.limits.title: Ngā here e mōhiotia ana
public.about.limits.1: He mea tuhi ā-ringa ngā tawhā tauira hua (te paemahana taketake, te wā wera ki te pihinga me te pakeketanga), ā, kāore anō he tohutoro.
public.about.limits.2: Nō HarvestStat anake te paearu rūpene mō 2000 ki 2007, ā, kāore i kitea he tuhinga paearu rūpene i te whakatō raraunga tuatahi.
public.about.limits.3: Ko ngā raraunga riha he kitenga GBIF e tata ana ki te pāmu. Ka whakaatu i ngā wāhi i tuhia ai tētahi momo e tata ana ki te pāmu.
public.about.limits.4: Kotahi te takiuru ngātahi o te whakamātau, ā, kei te pūmahara anake te aukati tono. Ka huna e te takiuru ngā whārangi papatohu, engari kāore e tiaki i ngā raraunga: ka taea e te katoa te pānui i te huinga raraunga. Engari ka tiakina ngā tuhinga katoa.

docs.stages.title: Pūnaha wāhanga
docs.stages.intro: Ka anga whakamua ngā kaupeka mā ngā wāhanga e ono:
docs.stages.guards: He tikanga taki mō ia nekehanga. Mō te wāhanga kua whakatōngia, me whai rā whakatō me tētahi hua; mō te tipu, me eke ki te paepae pihinga i ngā rā wera; mō mua i te hauhake, me eke ki te 90% o te paepae pakeketanga; mō te pakeketanga nā te mahana, me whakawhiti i te paepae pakeketanga; mō te arotake, me whai whakaahua raraunga huarere o te kaupeka me tētahi paearu kua whakatauria. Mō ngā taki GDD, me whai raraunga paemahana mō te 90% neke atu o te wā. Ka aukatia hoki te nekehanga mēnā kei te anamata tōna rā tīmata.

docs.seed.title: Whakatō raraunga
docs.seed.body: Ka tuhia e {0} te pāmu tauira, ngā māra, ngā hua me ngā kaupeka ki te huinga raraunga kua whakaritea, ā, ka tukutahi i ngā paerewa ā-rohe. Ka whakakapia te pāmu, ngā māra me ngā hua, nō reira whakamahia ki tō ake huinga raraunga anake.
guide.title: Me pēhea te whakamahi i Mecropolis
guide.lead: He aratohu poto, māmā hoki. Ka whakamārama i te mahi a te taupānga, mā wai, me ngā mahi o ia wāhanga.
guide.what.title: He aha a Mecropolis
guide.what.p1: He taupānga a Mecropolis hei aroturuki i ngā māra me ngā hua. Ka tatau i te whanaketanga o ia hua mā te tāpiri i te mahana mai i te whakatōnga. Ka whakaatu hoki i te huarere, te oneone me ngā riha huri noa i tō pāmu ki te wāhi kotahi.
guide.what.p2: I hangaia mō ngā pāmu o Western Cape i Awherika ki te Tonga, engari ka pai mō ngā pāmu, ngā rohe me ngā kaupeka katoa.
guide.who.title: Mā wai tēnei
guide.who.p1: Mā te tangata tiaki māra, pērā i te kaipāmu, te kaiwhakahaere pāmu, te kaitohutohu rānei.
guide.who.p2: Kāore he take kia mōhio koe ki te rorohiko, ki te pūtaiao huarere rānei. Ki te taea e koe te whakatuwhera paetukutuku, ka taea e koe te whakamahi Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: He aha koe ka whakamahi ai
guide.why.1: Ka kite wawe koe ko ēhea hua kātahi anō ka whakatōngia, ko ēhea e tipu ana, ko ēhea kua tata rite.
guide.why.2: Kāore koe e whakahou ā-ringa i ia māra. Ka neke aunoa te taupānga i ia hua ina tohu te huarere kua tae ki te wā.
guide.why.3: Ka whakatūpato mō te haupapa me te wera i ngā rā e tū mai nei, me ngā riha kua kitea tata ki tō pāmu.
guide.why.4: Ka noho tahi ngā kōrero katoa mō tētahi māra, pērā i te rehu, te riha i kitea, te tuhipoka rānei, me tōna rā, kia taea ai te titiro whakamuri.
guide.why.5: Ka whakaatu ia tau i tōna pūtake, kia mōhio ai koe ko ēhea ka pono.
guide.heat.title: Me pēhea te taupānga e mōhio ai ki te whanaketanga o te hua
guide.heat.p1: Ka tere ake te tipu i te mahana, ka pōturi i te makariri. Ka tatau a Mecropolis i tēnei mahana ia rā hei waeine mahana, arā, ko ngā growing degree days, ko GDD rānei.
guide.heat.p2: Ia rā, ka tango i te tau waenga o te paemahana teitei me te paemahana iti, kātahi ka tango i te paemahana e mutu ai te tipu. Ko te toenga ngā waeine mahana o taua rā. Kāore he tāpiritanga i te rā makariri.
guide.heat.p3: Me eke ia hua ki tētahi tapeke waeine mahana i mua i tōna rite. Ka tata te tapeke mai i te whakatōnga ki taua tau, ka neke te hua ki te wāhanga e whai ake nei.
guide.heat.p4: Nō Open-Meteo ngā paemahana. He ratonga huarere kore utu e tuhi ana i te huarere o ngā wāhi katoa o te ao.
guide.stages.title: Ngā wāhanga e ono
guide.stages.intro: Ka haere ia hua o ia māra mā ēnei wāhanga, i tēnei raupapa.
guide.stages.planning: Kua whakaritea te kaupeka, engari kāore anō te hua kia whakatōngia.
guide.stages.growing: Kei te kohi waeine mahana te hua.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Kua kohia te nuinga o te mahana e hiahiatia ana, nō reira me whakarite mō te hauhake.
guide.stages.harvested: Kua kohia katoatia te mahana e hiahiatia ana, nō reira kua rite pea. Māu anake e kī mēnā kua hauhaketia. Ka kī te taupānga kua pakeke i te mahana.
guide.stages.review: Kua mutu te kaupeka, ā, ka taea te arotake.
guide.stages.p2: Ka tirohia e te taupānga ia hua i ia pō, ā, ina tāpiri tētahi i tētahi kitenga, mahinga rānei. Ka taea hoki te pēhi Tirohia ināianei i tētahi kaupeka kia tirohia tonutia.
guide.start.title: Hei tīmata
guide.start.1: Whakatuwheratia te whārangi kāinga. Ka kite koe i te mahere huarere, te oneone, ngā riha me ngā hua hauhake o te pāmu tauira, kāore he takiuru.
guide.start.2: Pēhia Takiuru ki runga, ka whakamahi i ngā taipitopito pūkete tauira i hoatu ki a koe.
guide.start.3: Kōwhiria he pāmu. Ka huaki te paewhiri o taua pāmu.
guide.start.4: Pēhia tētahi kaupeka kia kite i ngā kōrero katoa mō taua hua i taua māra.
guide.start.5: Whakamahia te pouaka reo ki runga o tētahi whārangi hei huri reo. Ka maumahara te taupānga ki tō kōwhiringa ā muri ake.
guide.home.title: Te whārangi kāinga
guide.home.p1: Ka whakaatu te whārangi kāinga i tētahi mahere ā-rohe kua whakakākahutia ki te nui o te mahana kua riro i te whenua i tēnei kaupeka. Ka whakaatu hoki i te huarere o nāianei me ngā rā e tū mai nei, te oneone o te pāmu tauira, ngā riha i kitea tata nei, me te hua hauhake toharite o te rohe. Kāore he takiuru e hiahiatia ana.
guide.dashboard.title: Te paewhiri pāmu
guide.dashboard.intro: Ka whakaatu te paewhiri i tētahi pāmu. Ko ēnei ōna wāhanga mai i runga ki raro. Mā te pouaka pāmu ki runga e whakawhiti ai koe ki tētahi atu pāmu.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Whakarāpopoto pāmu
guide.dashboard.summary: Te maha o ngā māra me ngā ha o te pāmu, ngā kaupeka e haere ana, me ngā hua kua rite.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Me aro atu
guide.dashboard.alerts: He whakatūpato poto, pērā i te haupapa, te wera rānei kei te matapae, he hua kua rite, he kaupeka kāore i tīmata i te wā tika, he riha rānei kua kitea tata ki tētahi māra. Ka kī ia whakatūpato i tōna take.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Āhuatanga pāmu
guide.dashboard.conditions: Te huarere o tēnei rā, te matapae, te oneone me ngā riha tata ki tēnei pāmu.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Te haere o te kaupeka
guide.dashboard.progress: He kāri mō ia hua e whakaatu ana i te nui o te mahana kua kohia. Ka taea te whakataurite i ngā māra, me te tikiake i te rārangi hei kōnae ripanga (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Ngā māra
guide.dashboard.fields: Ngā māra katoa o te pāmu, me te rahi, te oneone me ngā hua o ia māra.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Rapu kōrero
guide.dashboard.search: Patohia ki ngā kupu noa tāu e rapu ana, pērā i ngā kutu rau i te wīti. Ka kimi i ngā kitenga me ngā mahinga he ōrite te tikanga, ahakoa he kupu kē i whakamahia.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Ngā tūtohutanga
guide.dashboard.recommendations: He mahi kua tūtohua mō tētahi māra, pērā i te rehu, te tongi rānei. Ka taea te whakaae, te whakakore rānei i ia tūtohutanga, ā, ka tohu kua oti ina mutu te mahi.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ngā mahi tata nei
guide.dashboard.activity: He rārangi o ngā wā i neke ai ia hua ki tētahi wāhanga hou.
guide.season.title: Te whārangi kaupeka
guide.season.intro: Ko te kaupeka he hua kotahi i te māra kotahi i te tau kotahi. Kei tōna whārangi ngā kōrero katoa.
guide.season.top.label: Runga o te whārangi
guide.season.top: Te hua, te māra, te rā whakatō, te rā hauhake e whakaarotia ana, me te hua hauhake ina tāurua e koe.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ngā wāhanga tipu
guide.season.pipeline: Ngā wāhanga e ono, kua tohua te wāhanga o nāianei. Pēhia Tirohia ināianei kia kite tonu mēnā me neke te hua.
guide.season.readiness.label: Kua rite kia neke?
guide.season.readiness: He rārangi o ngā mea e hiahiatia ana e te taupānga i mua i te neke i te hua, pērā i te rā whakatō me te nui o ngā raraunga huarere. Ka kī ia tūemi Kua pai, Whakatūpato, Kua āraia rānei. Ki te āraia, ka kī he aha kei te ngaro.
guide.season.evidence.label: Ngā taunakitanga
guide.season.evidence: Ngā kōrero i whakamahia e te taupānga mō āna whakatau, kia taea ai e koe te tirotiro.
guide.season.propose.label: Tuku tūtohutanga
guide.season.propose: Tūtohua he mahi mō tēnei māra, me ngā taunakitanga o te kaupeka. Ka noho hei hukihuki kia whakaaetia e tētahi i te paewhiri.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: He tūtohi o ngā waeine mahana e tāpiri haere ana mai i te whakatōnga, me tētahi rārangi mō te tapeke e hiahiatia ana e te hua.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ka pēhea mēnā?
guide.season.whatIf: Whakamātauria he rā whakatō tōmua, tōmuri rānei, he kaupeka mahana ake, makariri ake rānei, ka kite ai i te rerekētanga o ngā waeine mahana. Kāore he mea e tiakina.
guide.season.summary.label: Whakarāpopoto kaupeka
guide.season.summary: He whakarāpopoto poto o ngā kōrero o te kaupeka, nā AI i tuhi. Hei āwhina noa tēnei. Tirohia ngā kōrero mēnā he mea hē.
guide.season.notes.label: Ngā tuhipoka kaupeka
guide.season.notes: He tuhipoka whai rā mō te kaupeka. Ka taea te tāpiri, te huri, te muku, me te whakahoki mai i tētahi putanga tawhito.
guide.season.files.label: Whakaahua māra me te pūrongo whakamātautau oneone
guide.season.files: Tukuake he whakaahua o te māra me te PDF whakamātautau oneone a te taiwhanga.
guide.season.log.label: Rātaka māra
guide.season.log: Ngā mea i kitea e koe i te māra, me ngā mahi i mahia, pērā i te rehu me tōna hua me te inenga.
guide.season.history.label: Hītori whakarerekētanga
guide.season.history: Ngā huringa katoa kua tiakina mō tēnei kaupeka, me ōna rā.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Paerewa ā-rohe
guide.season.benchmark: Te hua hauhake toharite o te rohe mai i ngā tatauranga tūmatanui. Hei whakataurite noa, ehara i te hua hauhake o tō māra.
guide.season.pests.label: Ngā kitenga riha ā-rohe
guide.season.pests: Ngā riha kua pūrongotia tata ki te māra i GBIF, he pātengi raraunga tūmatanui mō ngā kitenga. Pēhia Tikina ngā kitenga kia whiwhi i ngā mea hou.
guide.sources.title: Nō hea ngā tau
guide.sources.weather: Nō Open-Meteo te huarere o tēnei rā, te matapae me ngā rā o mua.
guide.sources.soil: Nō SoilGrids te oneone, he mahere oneone o te ao.
guide.sources.pests: Nō GBIF ngā kitenga riha, he pātengi raraunga tūmatanui mō ngā kitenga.
guide.sources.yields: Nō USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa me te World Bank ngā hua hauhake ā-rohe.
guide.sources.you: Ko ērā atu mea, pērā i ngā tuhipoka, ngā mahinga me ā koutou ake hua hauhake, nāu, nā tō rōpū rānei i tāuru.
guide.limits.title: Ngā mea kāore e taea
guide.limits.model: Ko ngā waeine mahana e hiahiatia ana e ia hua he whakatau tata nā mātou, ā, kāore anō kia whakamātauria i te māra. Hei aratohu noa. Whakapono ki tāu e kite ana i tō māra.
guide.limits.maturity: Ko te maoa ā-wera, e ai ki te huarere kua rite te hua. Māu anake e mōhio mēnā kua tino rite.
guide.limits.translation: Nā AI ngā whakamāoritanga i tuhi. Me māmā te whai, engari kāore anō tētahi kaikōrero Māori kia tirotiro i ngā reo katoa.
guide.limits.demo: E wātea ana te whakaaturanga ki te katoa, nō reira kaua e tuhi kōrero tūmataiti ki roto.
